title: SupervisorDecision
description: Output of the Leila supervisor agent. Allowed values are hold, request_human, reject, reroute.

action.description: Supervisor can hold, request human review, reject, or reroute. Cannot send or delete.

reroute_department.description: Target department when action is reroute; null otherwise.

decision_hash.description: Deterministic hash of the exception context.
